name: Hollow tree - service tunnel
notes: This is a physical service and escape tunnel, not a portal. It connects the Hollow Tree's lower chamber to the Hidden hatch near the far side of the Fairy Ring glade. Coinín may use it after a failed patrol-avoidance check so the Mission continues with lost Cover, pursuit, or suspicion rather than capture.
atmosphere: Cold soil, close walls, and the muffled vibration of equipment hidden behind root-shaped panels.
description: A narrow maintenance passage threaded between the roots beneath the Hollow Tree. It is cramped and earthen-looking, but regular supports and fitted panels betray deliberate construction.
